_doc: Local notifications (src/autoload/notifications.gd). Each kind has a delay rule and several lines; one is picked without repeating the last one. {level}, {realm}, {boss}, {hero}, {coins} are filled from the save. Voice: the game's own characters, short, specific, a little cheeky. Never guilt, fake urgency or fake rewards. priority: lower wins when two reminders fall on the same day.

push._doc: Firebase Cloud Messaging topics (send campaigns to them from the Firebase console, see docs/NOTIFICATIONS.md). The player is subscribed only while notifications are on in Settings and the Android permission is granted. opened_window_ms: a push delivered this soon after launch/resume counts as the player tapping it.

lines: The wheel is spinning itself out of boredom
Your free spin is back. Master Orin swears he did not oil it for you.
Fresh spin, still warm
A new free spin just landed. Go see what the wheel coughs up today.
Spin. It. Again.
Today's free spin is ready, Commander. The coins are not going to fling themselves.
Wheel status: ready
One free spin, zero excuses. Tap to spin.
Day {streak_next} chest is packed
Your daily reward is waiting in the courtyard. Rocky is guarding it. Badly.
The quartermaster has your loot
Day {streak_next} of your login rewards is ready to claim.
Free coins. Seriously.
Your daily reward has arrived. It is literally just sitting there.
{stars_short} stars from a realm chest
So close. Three good shots and the {realm} chest opens.
The chest is rattling
You are {stars_short} stars away from the next realm chest in {realm}.
The archers are getting cocky
Level {level} is still standing. Rumour says they are building a second floor.
Rocky misses you
He has been staring at the catapult for two days. It is getting weird. Level {level} awaits.
Fortress report
Level {level}: still intact. Morale: insufferable. Your move, Commander.
Hey, siege person
That castle on level {level} will not knock itself down. Probably.
The {boss} is giving speeches now
Five days without a siege and he thinks he won. Prove him wrong on level {level}.
Blaze is lighting things out of boredom
Mostly harmless things. Give him a fortress before it gets serious.
The Vanguard took up knitting
Five days off. They made a scarf for the catapult. Please send them back to work.
We kept your catapult loaded
No pressure. Level {level} is right where you left it whenever you are ready.
The kingdom still needs you
Master Orin has new upgrades on the bench and {coins} of your coins are gathering dust.
New in the kingdom
Fresh castles, new contraptions and a few rude surprises. Come smash them.
Patch notes, but louder
The update is in. New things to break. You know what to do.
Master Sieges unlocked
You earned 25 stars. Ten nasty castles that only fall to clever contraptions are open.
